args.message: The table has four regions plus one group for customers with no region (region shown as null). Arctic has no customers, so it isn't listed. The null group is one customer (id 9002) with a 500 credit limit. Its 16 orders are 10 placed by that customer and 6 that have no customer. All 202 customers are counted, including any who never ordered. The order counts add up to 5,016, which matches the total number of orders.
